# Data preparation
## Load the libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
```

## Read data
```{r}
source("load_data.R")
```
```{r}
head(df)
```



# Modelling
## Model selection

```{r}
m1 <- lmer(mean_rating ~ Category + Group + (1 | Participant) + (1 | ImageNumber), data=df)
m2 <- lmer(mean_rating ~ Category * Group + (1 | Participant) + (1 | ImageNumber), data=df)
anova(m1, m2)
```


```{r}
m3 <- lmer(mean_rating ~ Category * Group + (1 + Category | Participant) + (1 | ImageNumber), 
           data = df)
anova(m3, m2)
```

```{r}
m4 <- lmer(mean_rating ~ Category * Group + (1 + Category | Participant) + (1 + Group | ImageNumber), 
           data = df)
anova(m3, m4)
```




## Best model

```{r}
best_model <- m4
summary(best_model)
Anova(best_model)
```
## Post hoc
```{r}
emm_options(pbkrtest.limit = 3700) 
emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 3700)
emm_results <- emmeans(best_model, ~ Group * Category)


# We split the comparison by Category to see the Group difference in Minus and Plus separately
post_hoc_stats <- pairs(emm_results, by = "Category", reverse = TRUE, adjust = "tukey")

# Display the statistical results 
cat("\n--- Post-hoc Comparisons: Neurotypical vs ASD within each Category ---\n")
summary(post_hoc_stats, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
```

```{r}
# This focuses on the magnitude of the difference between groups
cat("\n--- Effect Sizes (Cohen's d) ---\n")
eff_size_results <- eff_size(emm_results, sigma = sigma(best_model), edf = df.residual(best_model))

# Extracting only the estimate to keep the output clean as requested
print(eff_size_results)
```


# Plotting


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = mean_rating, fill = Group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Category) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution Density of Mean Rating: ASD vs Control",
       x = "Mean Rating", y = "Density") +
  theme(
    # hjust = 0.5 centers the text
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ASD" = "#E64B35FF", "Neurotypical" = "#4DBBD5FF"))
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

# --- Updated Visualization Code (Spearman for small N) ---

# Global setting: Disable scientific notation
options(scipen = 999)

dims <- c("Hominess", "Naturalness", "Personalness", "Beauty", "Approachability")

df_item_means <- df |>
  dplyr::group_by(ImageNumber, Group, Category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(dims), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_corr_rating <- df_item_means |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(dims), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "Rating") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Dimension = factor(Dimension, levels = dims)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Rating)


ggplot(df_corr_rating, aes(x = Control, y = ASD)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "#4682B4", size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8, se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ Dimension, scales = "free_x") +
 
  stat_cor(
    aes(label = paste(after_stat(r.label), after_stat(p.label), sep = "~`,`~")),
    method = "spearman", 
    label.x.npc = 0.05, 
    label.y.npc = 0.95,
    digits = 3,
    size = 3.2,
    p.accuracy = 0.001
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Item-level Mean Rating Correlation (Spearman)",
    x = "Control Group Mean Rating",
    y = "ASD Group Mean Rating"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1 
  )
```
